Who We Are

It's a network built on trust and precision, where every shipment is a new opportunity to move business forward.

Born from founder Ankush Salunkhe's passion for global trade, SanFreight is a dynamic alliance of expertise, commitment, and entrepreneurial spirit.


Our people are driven to push boundaries, explore new trade lanes, and stand out by delivering practical, sustainable solutions that meet today's freight challenges and anticipate tomorrow's.


Together, we create value.

Multimodal Logistics

Complete command of the freight value chain across global trade lanes.

Strategic Logistic Partner

Our specialists combine deep freight expertise with strategic vision to create lasting value. For you, we identify the most effective routes and solutions while managing risk at every step. Our approach is defined by a constant pursuit of reliable, cost-effective performance aligned with your business goals.

Logistics Operator

We play a central role in keeping global trade moving, committed to planning, executing, and optimizing every shipment while anticipating what comes next. By combining hands-on operational expertise with strategic vision, our team designs solutions that are efficient, reliable, and built to scale.

"Our 5 pillars of logistics expertise"

SanFreight delivers comprehensive, integrated management across every mode of freight. Leveraging our multi-sector expertise, we cover every stage of the supply chain, from planning the right route to the operational and strategic handling of cargo, door to door.

Ocean Freight

FCL and LCL shipments across all major ports, backed by strong shipping-line partnerships worldwide.
